name: National Overseas Scholarship for ST Candidates (NOS)
short_description: Financial assistance to meritorious Scheduled Tribe students for pursuing Master's and Ph.D. level courses abroad in prestigious global universities.
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
stipend_amount: Tuition fees + Annual Maintenance Allowance ($15,400 / £9,900) + Airfare

required_documents.name: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Caste Certificate
required_documents.description: Authorized ST certificate proving tribal community lineage

required_documents.name: Family Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Total family income from all sources not exceeding ₹6,00,000 per annum

required_documents.name: Unconditional Foreign University Offer Letter
required_documents.description: Offer of admission from a QS/Times top-ranked foreign institution

required_documents.name: Qualifying Degree Marksheet / Certificate
required_documents.description: Minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in Bachelor's/Master's degree

required_documents.name: Valid Passport Copy
required_documents.description: First and last page of valid Indian passport

form_fields.name: has_unconditional_offer
form_fields.label: Do you hold an unconditional offer letter?
